user.title: Add Rotel amplifier
user.description: Enter the network address of the amplifier and the TCP port of its control interface (9500 by default).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the amplifier.
data_description.port: TCP port of the Rotel control interface.
data_description.model_profile: Determines the list of inputs and the volume range.
data_description.name: Optional name of the device.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to the Rotel amplifier
reauth_confirm.description: The amplifier did not answer. Check that it is powered on and reachable, then update the connection settings.

reconfigure.title: Change the Rotel amplifier connection
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings of the amplifier.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect: the device did not answer the Rotel protocol on this address and port.

abort.not_rotel: The discovered device is not a Rotel amplifier.
abort.not_supported: The discovered device does not expose a usable address.

data_description.poll_interval: How often the amplifier is asked for its state. Keep it at 2 s unless you see problems on the network.
